_comment: Phase A validation sheet for the Warrior, cut from the APPROVED master at
assets/warrior weaw.png. No art was invented — every frame is a real pose
from that sheet, reduced by one uniform factor and aligned on one baseline.
bodyHeight 26 matches SPECS.warrior.h in gfx/actors.js exactly, so the
sprite Warrior stands the same height as the procedural one and the game's

bodyHeight 18 is the MEASURED drawn height of the procedural Warrior at scale 1.0 (25px at combat's 1.4x). SPECS.warrior.h=26 is a nominal UI value, not the drawn height - authoring to 26 made the sprite 44% too tall.
LIMITATION: these master poses hold a sword and shield, so equipment is
baked into this validation sheet. Production frames must be authored
EMPTY-HANDED so weapons and shields can be layered per-frame anchors.
jump / dodge / hurt / down have no equivalent pose in the master and are
left out — the renderer falls those states back toward idle until real
